name: modify_order_items
description:
Change the line items on an order that is still pending, adjusting stock reservations to match. The mode selects the operation and determines which fields each entry in items needs:
  add     - sku and quantity; adds units, creating the line if it is not present.
  remove  - sku, and quantity to remove part of a line; omit quantity to remove the line entirely.
  replace - sku (the line to change) and replacement_sku (what to swap in); quantity is carried over.
An order cannot be emptied this way; cancel it instead.

mode.description: Which operation to apply to every entry in items.

items.description: Entries to apply. Required fields depend on mode; see the tool description.

sku.description: Variant identifier. In replace mode, the line being changed.

quantity.description: Units. Required for add; optional for remove; ignored for replace.

replacement_sku.description: Required for replace mode only: the variant to swap in.

error_returns.when: The order does not exist, or a named SKU is not on the order.
mode is not add, remove or replace; items is empty; a replace entry omits replacement_sku; the quantity to remove exceeds the line; or the change would empty the order.
The order is not pending. Only pending orders can be modified.
An add or replace would reserve more units than are available.
